verification_result.explanation: Confirmed logic error in SyntacticScopeCreator.scanVars for Token.CATCH. The method declares the catch variable directly in the current `this.scope` via `declareVar(var)` and then scans the catch block with the same scope object (`scanVars(block)`), without creating any catch-local/nested scope. Because GlobalNamespace/CheckGlobalNames obtains scope information through this creator (as shown in the stack), the catch name is modeled in the wrong scope, which can cause later name-resolution to treat the catch variable incorrectly during global-name analysis. The suspicious lines 157-158 are therefore the root cause.
